plan.objective: Make repairability and long-term ownership tangible through real product imagery.
plan.audience: Laptop buyers who value customization, repairability, and upgrades.
plan.verifiedEvent: Framework Laptop 13 is designed to be customizable, upgradeable, and repairable.
plan.proof: The official Laptop 13 overview, upgrade materials, guides, and an exact current-model packshot/service view.
plan.visualAnchor: An official current-model packshot paired with an official open or service view.
plan.supportingDetail: Replaceable and upgradeable parts are documented in official guides.
plan.intendedReaction: Associate ownership with visible, credible repair and upgrade access.
plan.formatReason: A premium hero poster can make one product and one modular detail dominant.
plan.caption: Framework Laptop 13 is designed to be customizable, upgradeable, and repairable. The ownership story becomes credible when the real product and documented service access stay in view.

No mixed generations, fabricated ports, internals, or exploded views.
